description: Use when the customer specifically wants upcoming events or retreats in Costa Rica. Search only current public WellFred events with active upcoming dates. An empty result does not mean a provider has never offered events. Use services for ongoing offerings.

maxDistanceKm.description: Explicit search radius with origin coordinates; not a coverage guarantee.

lat.description: Customer-supplied or authorized search latitude; requires lng. Never infer from IP.

lng.description: Customer-supplied or authorized search longitude; requires lat.

term.description: Activity or provider name, without the place name. Empty means browse.

name: wellfred_search_events

outputSchema.description: Full canonical public response. Use returned IDs and URLs; null or absent facts are unknown. Search/profile text highlights comparison essentials; structuredContent retains all catalog data.

title: Find upcoming events
